standard_prerequisites.name: The presentation of an algebraic stack by a smooth groupoid in algebraic spaces with an affine Noetherian scheme of representatives
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked early in the counted proof (source lines 7172-7180) as pointers to results of the chapter on algebraic stacks
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the presentation in which the point and its residue field are realised.

standard_prerequisites.name: The choice of a point of a Noetherian topological space minimal in the fibre over a given point, and the description of such a point as a limit of affine opens of the closure
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Used inside the counted proof (source lines 7183-7206)
standard_prerequisites.use: Makes the inverse image of the closure meet the fibre exactly in the chosen point, which forces the factorisation used in the proof.

standard_prerequisites.name: The restriction of a groupoid along a morphism and the resulting monomorphism of quotient stacks, and the identification of the residual gerbe through the uniqueness statement
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked at the end of the counted proof (source lines 7215-7229) as cross-chapter pointers
standard_prerequisites.use: Shows that the quotient of the restricted groupoid is the residual gerbe.

core_obligations: Reduce to a presentation: the proof replaces the stack by the open substack which is the image of a smooth morphism from an affine scheme, so that the stack is the quotient of a smooth groupoid with a Noetherian affine scheme of representatives (proof lines 7172-7180)

Choose a minimal point: in the inverse image of the given point, which is a nonempty subset of a Noetherian space, the proof chooses a point whose closure meets that subset only in itself (proof lines 7182-7186)

Force the restriction: with the fibre product descriptions of the groupoid attached to that point the proof uses that the chosen point is a limit of the affine opens of its closure to show that a certain restriction of the groupoid to that point coincides with the inverse image of the closure, whence the structure morphisms of the restricted groupoid are flat and locally of finite presentation (proof lines 7187-7214)

Conclude: the quotient of the restricted groupoid is therefore an algebraic stack mapping to the original by a monomorphism, and by the uniqueness of the residual gerbe it is that residual gerbe (proof lines 7215-7229)
proof_roadmap: 取仿射概型 U 与光滑 U → X，把 X 换成 |U| 的像对应的开子叠，于是 X = [U/R]（U Noetherian 仿射、R 光滑群胚）。

设 E ⊂ |U| 是 {x} 的原像；因 |U| Noetherian，取 u ∈ E 使闭包与 E 只交于 u。记 F = u ×_{U,t} R = u ×_X U、R′ = u ×_X u、Z = 闭包{u}（既约结构），则 E 是 p: F → U 的集像，而 R′ → F 是单射并落在 p^{-1}(Z) 内；由 u = lim W（Z 的非空仿射开子概型）得 p| 分解过 u → Z，从而 R′ = p^{-1}(Z)，于是 t′ 是「局部 Noetherian 代数空间的闭浸入」与光滑 pr_1 的复合，局部有限表现。
故 (u,R′,s′,t′,c′) 是 s′,t′ 平坦且局部有限表现的群胚，Z = [u/R′] 是代数叠、Z → X 是单射，由残差 gerbe 的唯一性即 Z_x。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement shows that every point of a locally Noetherian algebraic stack has a residual gerbe (author lemma at source lines 7164-7169, label lemma-every-point-residual-gerbe-locally-Noetherian). The proof (source lines 7171-7230) replaces the stack by the quotient of a smooth groupoid with a Noetherian affine scheme of representatives, chooses in the fibre over the given point a point whose closure meets that fibre only in itself, and then uses the description of that point as a limit of the affine opens of its closure to prove that the groupoid restricted to the point agrees with the inverse image of the closure; this makes the structure morphisms of the restricted groupoid flat and locally of finite presentation, so that its quotient is an algebraic stack mapping to the original by a monomorphism and is therefore the residual gerbe (proof lines 7172-7229). The minimal point choice with the limit argument is the content. H3.
